title: Discount Allowed और Discount Received
intro:
भाग 1 — Accounting की नींव

कुल Problems: 4 │ 🟢 1 🟡 1 🟠 1 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Cash Discount को Nominal Account की तरह सही Record करना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

Discount Allowed (Expense) और Discount Received (Income) दो Ledger बनाएँ

Receipt/Payment Voucher में पार्टी का पूरा Bill Clear करें, Discount Ledger को अलग Line में डालें

Totals जाँचें

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Trade Discount (Invoice पर) को Cash Discount समझना

Discount को Party के खाते में Skip कर देना (Bill खुला रह जाता है)

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

Discount Allowed, Indirect Expense के Under आता है; Discount Received, Indirect Income के Under। दोनों को Receipt (F6)/Payment (F5) Voucher में Single Entry Mode में सीधे प्रयोग करें। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

🔥 Warm-Up Drill

Journal Entry बनाएँ

2Received cheque from Janvi ₹ 190 in full settlement of ₹ 200______________________

4Issued cheque in favour of Suraj ₹ 930 in full settlement of ₹ 1,000______________________

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Pass the necessary Receipt/Payment Vouchers in Tally Prime with the Discount ledger, and verify the total Discount Allowed and Discount Received.
guide:
Discount Allowed और Discount Received

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Discount Ledger और Voucher

  • Create → Ledger: "Discount Allowed" → Under = Indirect Expenses।
  • Create → Ledger: "Discount Received" → Under = Indirect Incomes।
  • Receipt (F6) / Payment (F5) खोलें। Party का पूरा Bill Credit/Debit करें (Agst Ref चुनें, ताकि Bill पूरा बंद हो)।
  • Cash/Bank की रकम असली मिली/दी रकम रखें, और Discount Ledger में फ़र्क की रकम डालें। (दो Ledger Dr/Cr रखने के लिए Ctrl+H से Double Entry Mode।)
  • Voucher Save करें → Outstanding में Party का Bill शून्य होना चाहिए।
याद रखें

ग्राहक से लेना: Cash/Bank Dr + Discount Allowed Dr = Party Cr (पूरा बिल)।

सप्लायर को देना: Party Dr (पूरा बिल) = Cash/Bank Cr + Discount Received Cr।

Trade Discount (Invoice पर) की अलग Entry नहीं होती; यह सिर्फ़ Cash Discount का Chapter है।

problems.title: Discount Ledger with GST-Registered Parties
problems.q:
🟠 Advanced

इस Problem में हर Party Regular GST Dealer है — Discount सिर्फ़ Payment/Receipt Voucher में एक अलग Ledger के रूप में लगेगा, Sale/Purchase Invoice पर नहीं (Original GST Invoice अलग से पहले ही बन चुका माना जाए)।

  • 1st June — Received cheque from Meridian Traders ₹ 47,500 in full settlement of their outstanding bill of ₹ 50,000; deposited into Bank the same day
  • 2nd June — Paid to Orion Suppliers by cheque ₹ 38,200 against their bill of ₹ 40,000
  • 2nd June — Received cash from Zenith Corp ₹ 18,000 against their bill of ₹ 20,000
  • 30th June — Paid to Orion Suppliers, by cheque, ₹ 24,500 in full settlement of a second bill of ₹ 25,000
problems.full:
ध्यान दें

Original GST Invoice पहले बन चुका है। Discount सिर्फ़ Payment/Receipt Voucher में Ledger के रूप में लगेगा, Sale/Purchase Invoice में नहीं।

हिसाब

  • Meridian: 50,000 − 47,500 = 2,500।
  • Orion Bill-1: 40,000 − 38,200 = 1,800। Orion Bill-2: 25,000 − 24,500 = 500।
  • Zenith: 20,000 − 18,000 = 2,000।

problems.title: Month-End Discount Policy — 4 Customers
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

Company की Policy: समय पर पूरा Payment करने वाले Customer को Outstanding का 5% Cash Discount मिलता है; आंशिक (Partial) Payment पर कोई Discount नहीं मिलता।

  • 1st April — Customer 'A' owed ₹ 60,000; paid the full amount by cheque within the discount period
  • 1st April — Customer 'B' owed ₹ 45,000; paid the full amount by cash within the discount period
  • 2nd April — Customer 'C' owed ₹ 80,000; paid only ₹ 50,000 by cheque (partial payment — no discount applies; remaining ₹ 30,000 stays outstanding)
  • 2nd April — Customer 'D' owed ₹ 36,000; paid the full amount by cash within the discount period
problems.full:
Policy

पूरा Payment समय पर → Outstanding पर 5% Discount। आंशिक Payment → कोई Discount नहीं।

हिसाब

  • A: 60,000 × 5% = 3,000; Cheque 57,000।
  • B: 45,000 × 5% = 2,250; नकद 42,750।
  • C: सिर्फ़ 50,000 Cheque से मिले → Discount नहीं। Agst Ref में Part Payment चुनें; ₹30,000 Outstanding रहेगा।
  • D: 36,000 × 5% = 1,800; नकद 34,200।
